subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed `sessions_spawn` preserve the async accepted response and then terminalize failed child startup, or should it preflight enough sandbox startup work to reject before returning accepted?
rationale: That choice changes the public async spawn contract, session/registry state, gateway waits, and the overlap with broader startup lifecycle work, so automation should not pick the permanent behavior alone.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted response contract and add typed/logged terminal startup failure state for child sessions and waits.

options.title: Preflight Sandbox Before Accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation before acceptance to fail fast, accepting extra latency and upgrade review.

options.title: Resolve In Broader Lifecycle Work
options.body: Keep this issue open while a maintainer-sponsored lifecycle PR covers both first progress and sandbox-start failure semantics.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted response contract and add typed/logged terminal startup failure state for child sessions and waits.

likelyOwner.reason: The subagent registry/lifecycle history makes this the strongest available owner for the API behavior choice.
